tls: operator-managed certificate/rotation and restricted network access; no public activation authorized
authentication: separate reader/admin secret files with owner/service-account ACLs; no anonymous artifact routes
scheduler: existing Password/Limited startup + repetition profiles, explicit PSCredential required
monitoring: independent authenticated readiness, task lifecycle/exit, backup age and audit-capacity checks required
limits: per-process limits only; distributed limiting and hard memory isolation require deployment review
recovery: encrypted private off-host destination and independent key custody require user authorization and actual restore test
activation: USER_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED; no accounts, cloud resources or credentials created
